name: LTX-2.3 Personal A2V LoRA Trainer
desc: Official Lightricks LTX-2.3 trainer for Audio-to-Video LoRA training, with JupyterLab, W&B, preprocessing and automatic model download.
readme: Use persistent storage mounted at /workspace. Before starting, accept the model terms for Lightricks/LTX-2.3 and google/gemma-3-12b-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized, then set HF_TOKEN as a Docker environment variable. This template sets AUTO_DOWNLOAD_MODELS=1, so startup downloads the LTX-2.3 dev checkpoint and Gemma into /workspace/models before Jupyter starts. Set JUPYTER_TOKEN to a strong secret. After startup, upload dataset.json plus videos into /workspace/dataset/raw/, copy configs/a2v_personal.yaml.example to configs/a2v_personal.yaml, set WANDB_API_KEY, then run preprocess_a2v.sh and train_a2v.sh in tmux. Do not place HF_TOKEN or WANDB_API_KEY in notebooks, image tags or template files.
env: -p 8888:8888 -e AUTO_DOWNLOAD_MODELS=1 -e LTX_MODELS_DIR=/workspace/models -e HF_HOME=/workspace/.cache/huggingface -e WANDB_DIR=/workspace/logs/wandb -e WANDB_PROJECT=ltx23-personal-a2v -e JUPYTER_TOKEN=CHANGE_ME -e HF_TOKEN=SET_IN_VAST_SECRET_ENV -e WANDB_API_KEY=SET_AFTER_DATA_PREPROCESSING
